description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when someone wants an AI agent inside one of their systems, for example "let the assistant read my contacts and deals and add follow-up tasks". It checks the wish against what an agent can do in that system and returns the record types it would read or change, the groups of actions, and a link that opens the setup in CRM Connector filled in, where the person signs in to the system and reviews everything. Every plan is saved as a new concept: a setup kept for later, not an AI agent, so nothing works until the person opens the link and finishes it in CRM Connector, where a signed in account also finds it under AI Agents. Nothing saved earlier is changed: a changed plan is a new concept with its own link, so share the newest one. Without record types it plans reading every record type the system offers. Call get_ai_agents_info with the system first when you do not know what it offers. Not for syncing records between two systems (use plan_integration).

action_groups.description: Optional groups of the system's own actions to switch on, as get_ai_agents_info names them for that system, for example adding notes and tasks.

change_record_types.description: Optional record types the assistant may read and change, each change shown to the person first.

read_record_types.description: Optional record types the assistant may read and not change.

system.description: The system the agent works in, by its key.

name: plan_ai_agent
title: Plan an AI agent
